name: youtube-search-flashdata
description: Search YouTube videos by keyword with date, duration, feature and sorting filters. Return video IDs, channels and available statistics. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_search enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
